brief: JPMorgan economist Feroli forecasts August CPI at 0.38% m/m headline and 0.21% m/m core, a 2.37% over-year-ago core rate that barely rounds to 2.4%. The build: energy up 2.5% on a 4.2% motor fuel gain, food 0.2%, rent and OER soft, airfares firm near 26-27% over year ago, new and used vehicles and cell phones unchanged, drug prices still falling. The desk frames the print as 0.2% rounded versus 0.3% rounded. Feroli reads 0.2% as low enough for the Fed to hold and 0.3% as high enough to hike, and the bond market prices about a 63% chance of a 25bp hike on September 16. The scenario table, explicitly a trading desk view and not JPM Research, gives 30% to core between 0.20% and 0.25% with SPX up 50bp to 1.25%, and 10% to core above 0.30% with SPX down 1.5% to 2.5%. Options expiring September 11 price a 1.0% move. Neutral positioning and hedge fund re-grossing skew risk/reward to the upside on a Hold or Hawkish Hold, led by Momentum, Tech and Cyclicals, though the desk moved to Tactically Cautious/Neutral last week on chop into the print.
